next.reason: §1985:XIII.3.19.3 SR5: 'The highest permissible qualifier of a sum counter is the report-name.' 2023 qualified-data-name is 'data-name-1 [ data-qualifier ] … [ file-report-qualifier ]' (§2023:8.4.2.2.2), the file-report-qualifier being a single file-name or report-name placed last, and §2023:8.4.2.2.3 SR4 makes every data-qualifier a superordinate level ('Qualifiers shall be specified in the order of successively more inclusive levels in the hierarchy'). A sum counter is qualified by its group names and at most a report-name above them, as in 1985.
